This fixture is a tiny cBioPortal-shaped BRCA TCGA sample for offline tests.

It mirrors the public cBioPortal Datahub staging file layout:

- `data_clinical_patient.txt`
- `data_clinical_sample.txt`
- `data_mutations.txt`
- `case_lists/cases_sequenced.txt`

Source references:

- https://github.com/cBioPortal/datahub
- https://github.com/cBioPortal/datahub/tree/master/public/brca_tcga
- https://docs.cbioportal.org/file-formats/

The rows are minimized test data following the public file format, not a full
redistribution of the BRCA TCGA study.
